title: NewtonX Unveils Next-Generation Hub Combining Self-Serve Research with Synthetic Personas
summary: NewtonX launched the next generation of NewtonX Hub, a self-serve research intelligence platform that combines Synthetic Personas, self-serve primary research, custom analysis and visualization, and executive-ready reporting. The release introduces Isaac, a conversational research agent that lets users ask plain-language questions of survey and research data. CEO Sascha Eder described the future of research as "a continuous loop between synthetic and human research."
whyItMatters: NewtonX is consolidating human and synthetic research into one self-serve workflow, pushing further from the concierge expert-network model toward a software platform.
